name: trail
description: Trail: a file tree tab per git repo, the session's and outside ones, that follows Claude and shows the trail of what it read and edited

followTab.title: Tab follows Claude
followTab.description: on: the tab of the repo where Claude reads, edits or runs a command comes to the front by itself. off: tabs only change when you click.

sessionTab.title: Session repo tab
sessionTab.description: on: at session start, also opens a tab for the repo the session runs in, so the automatic switch reaches it. off: only opens what you ask for with /trail open.

reads.title: Reads too
reads.description: yes: the tab opens (or the card shows, in card mode) also when Claude only reads (Read, Grep, cat, grep, ls, Get-Content). no: only when it writes.

glyphs.title: Icons
glyphs.description: auto: Nerd Font icons when one is installed, except in the desktop app. nerd: always Nerd Font. plain: Unicode only.

column.title: Right column
column.description: What the right column shows when the tab opens: date (last modified) or size. The Σ button at the top switches it.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostic line
diagnostics.description: on: writes a gray line in the conversation each time the mod brings a tab to the front. off: only in the debug log.

replayAnimation.title: Replay animation
replayAnimation.description: classic: the usual replay, lights each command for 2 s. modern: a bar that walks to the file, folders opening child by child, a magnifier or pencil icon, counters.

liveAnimation.title: Live animation
liveAnimation.description: animated: each read or edit by Claude plays in the tab the short version of the replay animation (modern only). instant: the light comes on at once, as before.

opening.title: How the tab opens
opening.description: auto: Claude's first edit in a git repo opens its tab, and a tab closed by hand comes back on the next edit. card: as before, a card asks for permission on the first write in an outside repo, and a closed tab stays closed for the session.

bigFolder.title: Big folder
bigFolder.description: A folder with more files than this opens folded: only what Claude touched, what changed in git and 3 neighbours of each, the rest in clickable "… N files" blocks; the number in the header opens the whole folder. 0 turns it off.

dots.title: Dots
dots.description: The dots before the right column, one per thing Claude did to the file: purple read, orange edit, green new file, red removed, teal shell. The same thing done again right after, inside one answer, is one dot. Past this many dots the row goes compact: one dot a kind with its count. compact: always one a kind. off: no dots.

dotsOrder.title: Dots order
dotsOrder.description: time: the order Claude did them, the first against the right column. kind: grouped by colour, reads against the right column, then edits, then new, removed and shell.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: on: measures each hook's latency and the tab's render cost; every 60 s writes them to the debug log and to ~/.claude/mods-metrics/trail.json, and /trail metrics shows them now. off: measures nothing.
